author: CMS Collaboration
title: Measurement of properties of $B^0_s \to \mu^+ \mu^-$ decays and search for $B^0 \to \mu^+ \mu^-$ with the CMS experiment
abstract: Results are reported for the $B^0_s \to \mu^+ \mu^-$ branching fraction and effective lifetime and from a search for the decay $B^0 \to \mu^+ \mu^-$. The analysis uses a data sample of proton-proton collisions accumulated by the CMS experiment in 2011, 2012, and 2016, with center-of-mass energies (integrated luminosities) of 7 TeV (5 fb$^{-1}$), 8 TeV (20 fb$^{-1}$), and 13 TeV (36 fb$^{-1}$). The decay $B^0_s \to \mu^+ \mu^-$ is observed with a significance of 5.6 standard deviations. The branching fraction is measured to be $\mathcal{B}(B^0_s \to \mu^+ \mu^-) = [2.9 \pm 0.7(\text{exp}) \pm 0.2(\text{frag})] \times 10^{-9}$. No significant excess is observed for the decay $B^0 \to \mu^+ \mu^-$, and an upper limit of $\mathcal{B}(B^0 \to \mu^+ \mu^-) < 3.6 \times 10^{-10}$ is obtained at 95% confidence level. The $B^0_s \to \mu^+ \mu^-$ effective lifetime is measured to be $\tau_{\mu^+ \mu^-} = 1.70^{+0.61}_{-0.44}$ ps.
